Erie

Erie is a historical people name associated with the Lake Erie region. A Pennsylvania county-government account identifies Eriez communities on its lakeshore. Broader geography and later community histories need further review.

History of Erie County — Erie County, Pennsylvania ↗

Erie County's own history identifies the Eriez people as the source of the Pennsylvania county's name and describes their settlement on its lakeshore. This is a specific Pennsylvania historical connection for the Erie access point, rather than an inference from a modern lake or city name. Inspection: The county's indexed opening paragraph and explicit page identification as Erie County, PA were read. Direct fetch timed out. The paragraph actually names Eriez people; it is not a modern canal or unrelated Erie County source. The account's claim that the people were destroyed is not adopted. Supporting geographic excerpt; excluded from the substantive profile-source target.
